source.title: Stochastic Dynamics for the Dilute Ising Lattice Gas: Results and Open Problems

trace.notes: Normalized ARGUMENTS as the single zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/1610297 with document identifier 1610297. Local workflow source indexes identify the exact work as 'Stochastic dynamics for the dilute Ising lattice gas: Results and open problems', year 2001. The MPRF article landing page identifies the same work as 'Stochastic Dynamics for the Dilute Ising Lattice Gas: Results and Open Problems' by N. Cancrini and F. Martinelli, 2001, volume 7, issue 1, pages 39-50.

Failure mode: metadata_only with local network_or_dns_failure and paywalled_or_restricted archive access. Local shell fetching could not resolve zbmath.org or api.zbmath.org. Browser-side recovery found the exact MPRF article landing page and the University of L'Aquila repository record, but these exposed bibliographic metadata and abstract text only. The MPRF site states that archive papers require registration before the PDF file is available, and the University of L'Aquila record states that no files are associated with the product.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched by exact title, exact title plus PDF, title plus DOI, title plus authors and page range, and zbMATH identifier. Candidate pages were rejected because they were publisher or repository metadata, abstract-only pages, author profile snippets, citation listings, related follow-up papers, or different works. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML technical source containing the problem statements was recovered.

No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML technical source was recovered. The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from zbMATH metadata, local source-index rows, MPRF abstract text, repository metadata, author-profile snippets, citation pages, search snippets, or related works.
No candidates were accepted because there were no verbatim problem-statement quotes with page numbers or stable HTML locators from a readable primary source artifact.
